device.name: TwinCAT NC axis telemetry (ophyd-ads, read only)

facts.text: NcAxis is an ophyd Device whose fields are Component(AdsSignal, ...) declarations
The README describes ophyd-ads as ophyd integration with Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 via pyads
act_acc, act_pos, act_pos_modulo, act_torque, act_velo, axis_state, cmd_no, control_d_word, couple_state, ctrl_output and drive_output are Component(AdsSignal, ...) declarations of NcAxis
set_acc, set_pos, set_pos_modulo, set_torque and set_velo are also Component(AdsSignal, ...) declarations of NcAxis; this read-only package does not bind them
AdsSignal.get reads the Symbol value over ADS and updates the Signal value and timestamp
AdsSignal.put writes the value through the Symbol over ADS
AdsSignal parses an ADS address from read_pv and requires an IP address
AdsSignal obtains its Symbol from Plc.get_symbol with the _SignalSymbol class
Symbol.read reads the symbol by name with the ADS data type
Plc.get_symbol caches a Symbol by symbol name, poll rate and class, and opens the ADS connection when it is closed
Plc.stop sets running to False and queues a no-op
The Plc connection thread loops while running and closes the ADS connection when it exits
Plc.stop_polling removes a registered poll call from the poll thread

measures.description: Read the current value of one or more sensor channels and return the values with a sampling timestamp and a monotone sequence number. Volatile channels are also available by subscription.

inputs.description: Channel names to return: act_acc, act_pos, act_pos_modulo, act_torque, act_velo, axis_state, cmd_no, control_d_word, couple_state, ctrl_output, drive_output. Omit the input to return every channel; other names contribute no value

safe_state.description: unchanged: the package only reads axis symbols over ADS and never writes a setpoint; an e-stop engages the endpoint's software latch and stops nothing physical
